comparison.objective: Support a door, align interleaved hinge knuckles, and insert a pin through all five; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual heavy-part alignment and long coaxial pin insertion versus counterholding, recessed hex-key use, fine collar rotation, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Door supported by a pin passing through all five knuckles versus safe repeated stopping with locked setting. No numeric hinge clearances or separate specs are provided.
comparison.reason: Hinge assembly tests simultaneous alignment and insertion, not dynamic tuning.
